source.snippet: I built an AI desktop client specifically designed for non-programmers, which has the capabilities of Codex/Claude Desktop, but it is localized, protects all your privacy, and supports any model call. Would you like to try using it?

problem_statement: Non-technical users need a localized, privacy-preserving AI desktop client that supports multiple models without requiring programming knowledge, but existing tools like Claude Desktop and Codex are designed for developers.
target_segment: Non-programmer knowledge workers and small business owners who want AI assistance locally without cloud privacy concerns
notes: Builder is already paying to develop and distribute this; implies a paying market of non-programmers who want AI but are privacy-conscious. Weak signal — single post, no confirmed paying buyers yet, but product already exists suggesting some validation.
